title: Spicy Veggie Ground Stir-Fry with Noodles, Carrots, Bok Choy & Ginger

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion lengthwise. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, and mince ginger.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, ginger, and veggie ground; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim bok choy. Cut crosswise into strips.
When the veggie ground is done, add bok choy, carrots, stir-fry sauce, and chili-garlic sauce to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables have softened, 3-4 minutes.
When the pasta is done, drain in a colander. Add to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
